title: Table 1a, 5 by 5, mask 7586366: represented by an AND/OR circuit of fan-in at most two with at most 10 gates
statement: PEqualNP.Represents.RepSizeAtMost (fun u v : Fin 5 => (7586366 : ℕ).testBit (5 * u.val + v.val)) 10
unlocks: one entry on representing a five-by-five bipartite graph where a shared OR gate is known to help: 10 gates or 11, truth not known
context: SKETCH: truth not known to us; the opposite row is offered beside it. Proved by exhibiting ONE AND/OR circuit of fan-in at most two with at most 10 gates that is right at the 25 inputs with one left and one right vertex on. An 11-gate circuit with an OR gate read from both sides is known (computed, not checked); 10 gates are known to be needed, by a checked bound on an induced four-vertex path. Size: minutes if such a circuit exists. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.
